_comment: Class-tuning passes applied to the Midnight 12.1 PTR, newest first.
The dashboard's 'since latest tuning' filter compares each run's exact
start timestamp (epoch ms, UTC) against the cutoff for the region whose
PTR realm the run was played on, so a run is included only once tuning
was actually live for that region.
'regions' maps a WCL region code to the ISO8601 UTC instant the pass went
live there; 'default' covers any region not listed explicitly.
